title: 自国を守るには軍事力が必要…日本人に備わる「草の根の保守」　先人の覚悟引き継げるか
extracted_text: 築97年が経過した今も変わらぬ威容を誇っている。白く輝いた大理石が特徴的な東京・日本橋の三井本館。旧三井財閥の本拠地として知られるが、戦後日本の進路を方向づけた舞台でもある。昭和26（1951）年1月、吉田茂首相はここでダレス米特使と向き合っていた。同館は連合国軍総司令部（GHQ）の外交局として接収されていた。 当時朝鮮戦争が熾烈（しれつ）を極める中、日本の再軍備を強く求めたダレス氏に対し経済再生を優先したい吉田氏は抵抗。交渉は物別れに終わった。 吉田氏は25年8月の自衛隊の前身の警察予備隊創設には応じたが、再軍備には踏み切らなかった。近現代史研究家の福冨健一氏は『自由民主党の誕生』（中央公論新社）で、吉田氏が警察予備隊の本部長官に旧内務省出身者を起用したことに触れ、「警察組織であることを明確にする」と記す。他国の軍隊と異なり、自衛隊の行動は警察と同様に法律の根拠を細かく必要として制約が強くなっている。 もっとも占領期当初、日本が脅威とならぬよう再軍備を禁じたのは米国だった。GHQのマッカーサー最高司令官は「戦争放棄」など3原則に沿った「憲法草案」作成を民政局に命令。「陸海空軍その他の戦力」の保持を否定する9条2項の原点だ。
translated_text: Even after 97 years have passed, it still commands an unchanged majestic presence. The Tokyo-Nihonbashi Mitsui Main Building, distinguished by its gleaming white marble. Known as the former headquarters of the old Mitsui conglomerate, it was also the stage that shaped the course of post-war Japan. In January 1951 (Showa 26), Prime Minister Shigeru Yoshida faced here with U.S. Special Envoy Dulles. The building had been seized by the Allied Powers' General Headquarters (GHQ) for use as its diplomatic bureau. At the time, as the Korean War raged intensely, Yoshida resisted Dulles's strong push for Japan's rearmament, prioritizing economic recovery. The negotiations ended in a breakdown. While Yoshida had agreed to the creation of the Police Reserve Forces in August 1950, the predecessor to the Self-Defense Forces, he did not take the step toward rearmament. In 'The Birth of the Liberal Democratic Party' (Chuo Koron Shinsha), modern historian Kenichi Fukutomi refers to Yoshida's appointment of former Internal Ministry officials as the chief directors of the Police Reserve Forces, writing that it was to 'clarify that it is a police organization.' Unlike the militaries of other countries, the Self-Defense Forces' operations, like those of police, are subject to strong constraints requiring detailed legal justification. Originally, during the early occupation period, it was the United States that prohibited rearmament to ensure Japan would not become a threat. GHQ Supreme Commander MacArthur instructed the Civil Administration Bureau to create a constitution draft based on the three principles including 'renunciation of war.' This is the origin of Article 9, paragraph 2, which denies the possession of 'land, sea, air, or any other war potential.'
title_en: Military Power Necessary to Defend One's Own Country… 'Grassroots Conservatism' Among Japanese People: Can We Inherit the Resolve of Our Ancestors?
